description: NoteBox (no login): adding, searching, editing and deleting notes work; pinning does nothing, an empty title is not refused and the note counter ignores deletes.

claims.text: Add a note with a title and see it in the list
Type in the search box and the list narrows to the matching notes
Edit a note's title or text and save the change
Delete a note and it disappears from the list
Pin a note so it moves to the top of the list with a Pinned label
Adding a note with an empty title shows a clear message and adds nothing
A counter shows how many notes there are and goes down when a note is deleted

controls.text: Export the notes as a PDF file
